partnershipPlan: Two patient partners from the heart failure support group review the patient leaflet and the visit options before opening, and join the six-month service review.
socialListening: No social media listening; the service reads its patient comment cards for mentions of medicines and visits.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I was told the dose would go up at my next appointment, and that was five months away.
items.implication: Show patients the titration plan and the date of the next change at the first visit.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every test means a day off for me to drive him in.
items.implication: Offer community phlebotomy sites and tell families how many tests to expect.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I can prescribe, but I want the hold rules written down before I change four medicines.
items.implication: Keep hold and referral thresholds explicit in the protocol and supervised practice for the first 20 patients.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On the phone I say I am fine; it is when you see me stand up that you notice the dizziness.
items.implication: Let patients over 80 or with dizziness choose clinic visits.

summary: Four composite voices on waiting, test burden, nurse confidence and visit type.
